{{Quote|I'm sure I don't have to tell you this, but your boss is an idiot!"''<br />''"He is not my ''boss''. I am a Palace Guard. He is our ''leader''.. for now.|Galfridian and Kopri discuss Fey'lya|<ref name="Invasion: Revelations 4">[[Invasion: Revelations 4|''Invasion: Revelations'' 4]]</ref>}}
'''Kopri''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who served under [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Borsk Fey'lya]] as [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Palace Guard (New Republic)|Palace Guard]] at the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Prepare a cell for the assassin. I'm bringing him in alive.|Kopri|<ref name="Invasion: Revelations 4" />}}
While guarding the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] Kopri encountered [[Finn Galfridian]] and his droid [[Prowl]] as they attempted to break into the residence of Chief Fey'lya. After Finn, already wanted as an escaped assassin, successfully entered the building and confronted the Chief of State, she gave chase to the Jedi using a [[flutterpack]]. Eventually she captured Finn, but released him when Prowl forced a stalemate. After Finn explained the situation, they sought out the Imperial ambassador, who Finn claimed was a Vong infiltrator and the real assassin.

At ambassador [[Yarmond]]'s quarters, the pair confronted the masqued Vong. [[Zakar (Yuuzhan Vong)|Zakar]] grabbed Kopri from behind, as Yarmond attempted to force Finn to go with him to [[Tsalok]]. Kopri was freed when [[Dray (Fallen Jedi)|Master Dray]] arrived and killed Zakar. As Dray made his move against Yarmond, Finn and Kopri fled.

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Invasion: Revelations 4|''Invasion: Revelations'' 4]], Kopri introduces herself as Captain Kirpo when calling on the Imperial ambassador. [[Randy Stradley]] indicated on the [[Dark Horse Comics]] message boards that this typo would be corrected in the trade paperback version.
